commentary.text: 90+12' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+9' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal due to a foul. The West Ham players look gutted.
90+6' Wait! Referee Chris Kavanagh has indicated he is going to review the West Ham goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a foul in the build-up.
90+5' Goal! Callum Wilson (West Ham) fires the rebound into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:1.
90+5' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) steps up to send the ball in.
90+4' Callum Wilson (West Ham) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
90+2' The referee can't ignore those comments and Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) sees a yellow card for bad language.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
89' William Saliba (Arsenal) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
87' Fouls committed – 11:7.
85' Nuno Espirito Santo has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Callum Wilson (West Ham) replacing Axel Disasi.
83' 0 - 1 Goal! Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) picks up the ball inside the box, finds himself in a good position and fires in a shot which is deflected past Mads Hermansen. He makes it 0:1.
82' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
80' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Noni Madueke (Arsenal) will replace Bukayo Saka.
79' Cristhian Mosquera (Arsenal) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
79' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

79' David Raya was forced into action to thwart Mateus Fernandes (West Ham). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom left corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
77' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
77' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
76' David Raya leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Jarrod Bowen (West Ham).
76' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) serves up a nice cross, but David Raya punches the ball away.
75' El Hadji Malick Diouf (West Ham) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
74' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
73' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
72' El Hadji Malick Diouf (West Ham) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
71' The current number of shots on goal is 2:2.

67' Here is a change. Eberechi Eze is going off and Mikel Arteta gives the last tactical orders to Martin Odegaard (Arsenal).
66' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Taty Castellanos as he is replaced by Pablo (West Ham).
66' Nice passing game by West Ham. They are increasing their possession with a series of long passes and waiting for the right moment to create an attacking opportunity.
65' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
64' The foul by Cristhian Mosquera (Arsenal) was seen by Chris Kavanagh who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle. West Ham are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
62' Arsenal control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
61' 5:12 – the total goal attempt statistics.
59' Declan Rice (Arsenal) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.

58' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) tries his luck with a shot from long distance after receiving a good pass. He hits the ball poorly and sends it into orbit. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.
57' Arsenal hold the ball and are exchanging some long passes.
55' The Arsenal players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession.
54' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
52' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) sets himself up on the edge of the box, but balloons his shot way over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.
52' The Arsenal players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

49' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) blew a promising chance when he got to a rebound just outside the penalty area. He struck it low towards the middle of the target, but David Raya pulled off a nice save and to stop the attempt.
47' Arsenal hold the ball and are exchanging some long passes.

38' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) gets booked for the first time in this match.

36' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but the effort is well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Arsenal.
36' Arsenal hold the ball and are exchanging some long passes.
34' Taty Castellanos (West Ham) receives a yellow card.
33' Dangerous play by Taty Castellanos (West Ham). Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle for a foul.
32' A pass by Aaron Wan-Bissaka (West Ham) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Arsenal.
30' El Hadji Malick Diouf (West Ham) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
29' Neat passing move from Arsenal in order to create new attacking opportunities.
28' Problems for Mikel Arteta as Ben White is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Martin Zubimendi (Arsenal) replaces him.
27' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to David Raya, who smothers the ball.
23' Ben White (Arsenal) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
23' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team.
22' Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal) drifts into the box to meet the ball from the free kick and plants a header towards the right post. One of the defending players gets in its way and blocks it.
21' Poor challenge! Aaron Wan-Bissaka (West Ham) is penalised for tripping and Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle. It's a free kick to Arsenal in a dangerous position.
19' Arsenal seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
18' Ball possession – 29:71.
15' Chris Kavanagh has a clear sight and sees a foul from Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham). Arsenal will take a free kick.
15' West Ham are playing excellent possession football at the moment by exchanging some long passes.
13' Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
12' Great teamplay by Arsenal as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
10' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
10' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) blows an opportunity from close range as he heads a rebound onto the right post!

9' What a great chance for Leandro Trossard (Arsenal). He times his jump superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross from the corner, directing his towering header towards the top right corner, but the goalkeeper denies him with a miraculous save.
9' Declan Rice (Arsenal) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
8' Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
8' Nice passing game by Arsenal. They are increasing their possession with a series of long passes and waiting for the right moment to create an attacking opportunity.
7' Arsenal string together a series of short passes.

5' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the middle of the goal. Mads Hermansen is alert, though, and makes an easy save to deny him.

3' Ben White (Arsenal) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.
2' The West Ham players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
